reader.notes: The value is System.Random.NextDouble (range [0,1) by construction) from a run-unit RandomSequence; FromDouble lands it by its shortest round-trip decimal, whose largest case 0.9999999999999999 stays below 1, and a negative seed (outside AR1) takes the ArgumentError path that returns 0, still inside the range. Rounding to 1 under a receiver's ROUNDED phrase would be the statement's store, not the returned value.
